sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No candidate provides the absent canonical ordered-grade or comparison term needed for a Table 8 minimum-grade comparison; steelGrade is string-valued and must not be used for lexical ordering.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Replace the presence-only approximation with an actual Table 8 lookup and not-less-than validation. The case currently accepts any steelGradeValue and never checks the ship/plating's actual grade against the minimum grade selected from Polar Class, as-built thickness, material class, and strength category; it also omits the dependency-contract applicability term materialClass. Use one case node to pair the lookup inputs and result, constrain each lookup field to an unambiguous single value, encode the exact Table 8 selection, and compare actual grade in the correct ordering direction (actual grade >= required Table 8 grade). Do not compare ordered grades as strings. Activate vocabulary matching to locate the missing canonical actual-grade, grade-order, and/or Table 8 mapping terms or controlled values rather than inventing them.

Replace the presence-only case shape with an actual Table 8 lookup and comparison: validate that the cited-table minimum is selected from the paired as-built thickness, Polar Class, material class, and steel-strength category, then verify that the plating's actual steel grade is not less than that minimum using canonical ordered-grade/comparison terms. Locate those absent canonical terms with the matcher; do not compare the available string-valued steelGrade lexically. Also move polarClass, materialClass, asBuiltPlateThickness, and requiredHullStructuralSteelGrade checks to their authoritative ship owner, while retaining only relationships whose canonical domain requires the steel-grade case, and avoid duplicating facts on ship and case.
